import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import root

n = 150_000
log_n = np.log(n)
H_target = log_n - 10.0          # KL(P||U) = log n - H(P)
M_target = -log_n - 10.0         # KL(U||P) = -log n - mean(log p)

def build(d, eps):
    c = (1.0 - eps - d) / 6.0
    b = eps / (n - 7)
    p = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
    p[:6] = c
    p[6] = d
    p[7:] = b
    return p

def residuals(x):
    d, eps = x
    p = build(d, eps)
    H = -np.sum(p * np.log(p))
    M = np.mean(np.log(p))
    return [H - H_target, M - M_target]

sol = root(residuals, [0.232, 4.543e-5], method='hybr', options={'xtol': 1e-13})
print('success:', sol.success, sol.message)
print('d, eps:', sol.x)
p = build(*sol.x)

# Verify from the definition given in the task, independently of the algebra.
U = np.full(n, 1.0 / n)
fkl = np.sum(p * np.log(p / U))
bkl = np.sum(U * np.log(U / p))
print('sum:', p.sum(), 'min:', p.min(), 'max:', p.max())
print('finite/positive:', np.isfinite(p).all(), (p > 0).all())
print('forward KL:', repr(fkl), 'error:', abs(fkl - 10.0))
print('backward KL:', repr(bkl), 'error:', abs(bkl - 10.0))

np.save('/app/dist.npy', p)
print('saved', p.shape, p.dtype)
EOF
